user.title: Connect to Stirling PDF
user.description: Enter the full local URL of Stirling PDF. Use an API key if required by Stirling PDF. For the Community App's direct API port, enter your Home Assistant username and password as HTTP Basic credentials. Both methods can be combined. Basic credentials require HTTPS or a trusted isolated network.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Stirling PDF
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL or credentials. Saved secrets are never displayed. Leave a masked placeholder unchanged to keep its secret, enter a replacement, or clear it to remove it. To remove HTTP Basic authentication, clear both username and password. Changes are saved only after validation succeeds.

reauth_confirm.title: Update authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected access. Re-enter all credentials required by this deployment: the API key, HTTP Basic username and password, or both. Saved secrets are not prefilled. For the Community App, use your Home Assistant login credentials, not a long-lived access token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and whether Stirling PDF is running.
error.invalid_auth: The API key or HTTP Basic credentials are missing or invalid, or the server denied access.
error.invalid_basic_auth: Enter both HTTP Basic username and password, or leave both empty. The username must not contain a colon (:).
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL.
error.status_endpoint_disabled: Stirling PDF reported that its status endpoint is disabled. Enable the status endpoint in Stirling PDF and try again.

abort.already_configured: This server URL is already configured.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Stirling PDF configuration is not loaded.

path_not_allowed.message: The path `{path}` is not allowed by Home Assistant. Add its parent directory to `allowlist_external_dirs`.

invalid_extension.message: The path `{path}` must use the `{extension}` extension.

invalid_languages.message: Enter at least one valid OCR language code, such as `eng` or `deu`.

invalid_page_numbers.message: Enter positive page numbers or ascending ranges, for example `1,3-5`. Use at most 1024 characters. Expressions such as `all` or `2n+1` are not supported for extraction.

output_exists.message: The output file `{path}` already exists. Enable overwrite or choose another path.

authentication_failed.message: Stirling PDF rejected API access. Update authentication under Settings > Devices & services.

processing_failed.message: Stirling PDF could not process the document: {error}

file_error.message: Home Assistant could not read or write the file: {error}

invalid_server.message: Select a valid Stirling PDF server.

server_required.message: Multiple servers are configured. Select the server using config_entry_id.

action_group_disabled.message: Enable this action group in the selected server's integration options first.

remote_host_not_allowed.message: Provide an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials and explicitly allow its hostname in the selected server's options.

input_too_large.message: Additional tools accept at most 32 files with a combined 64 MiB and structured fields of at most 4 MiB.

tool_forbidden.message: The selected tool is forbidden for this server/account. Base authentication was not changed.
